main.description: List stored content classification results, newest first, each with the classified subject as the classifier would load it now, for instance administrators reviewing the classifier. Probabilities are integer parts per million. Admin identity comes from the authenticated service context, never request fields.

question.description: Return results that scored this policy question

minProbability.description: Return results whose probability for question is at least this many parts per million; requires question

subjectKind.description: Return results for this kind of subject

community.description: Return results for subjects in this community DID

modelId.description: Return results scored by this model

policyVersion.description: Return results scored under this policy version

since.description: Inclusive lower bound on the result's createdAt

until.description: Exclusive upper bound on the result's createdAt

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an instance administrator's service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor is not an instance administrator; do not retry.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter or limit is invalid, or minProbability was given without question; correct the request before retrying.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is invalid; restart pagination without a cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent at the end of pagination

id.description: Service-local result identifier, used to record a verdict

subjectUri.description: The classified subject: the AT-URI of a post or comment, or the DID of a community

scoredCid.description: CID of the subject version that was classified

authorDid.description: Author of the subject; the community itself for a community subject

policyVersion.description: Policy version the subject was scored under

probabilities.description: Probability of each scored question, sorted by question

imagesSent.description: Number of images sent to the classifier

imagesSkipped.description: Number of image slots not sent to the classifier

textTruncated.description: Whether the classified text was cut to the text limit

partial.description: Whether the result was stored from the answered image batches of a job that failed at the attempt limit; images never sent count as skipped. A partial result accepts a verdict and counts toward precision like any other

createdAt.description: When the result was stored, or last replaced: a revived job that completes replaces its partial result in place

scoredCidIsCurrent.description: Whether the subject is not deleted and its current CID is the scored CID; only such results accept a verdict

subjectView.description: The classified subject as the classifier would load it now, including content the public read path hides. Content and images are omitted when the subject is deleted or under an illegal-content or doxing action (for a comment, also when its root post or the post its parent chain reaches is)

visibility.description: Whether the subject is shown now

deleted.description: Whether the subject has been deleted

currentCid.description: The subject's current CID; absent when it is missing or deleted

postFields.description: The classified fields of a post

commentFields.description: The classified fields of a comment

communityFields.description: The classified fields of a community profile

imageRef.description: An image blob a subject shows

ownerDid.description: DID whose repository holds the blob
